_note: Suggested repair windows by OpenStreetMap road class. A rule of thumb that the admin can change here; it is not a traffic forecast. No general Bangkok or DOH rule on lane-closure hours was found (Research Desk, 15 Nov 2026); BMA road repairs have been reported at 22:00-05:00.

major.reason: Busy through road. Closing a lane in the day causes queues, so work at night when traffic is lightest, with lights and reflective signs. Bangkok (BMA) road repairs have been reported at these hours; check the road owner's own rule.

collector.reason: Local through road. Work between the morning and evening rush hours, in daylight.

local.reason: Quiet street. Daytime work is safer and easier to see; fewer parked cars while people are at work.

unknown.reason: Road type not known yet (press Update traffic in Repairs). Between rush hours is the safe default.
